name: @capital-q/integrations
description: Capital Q integrations bounded context (BIZ-007): a person's connected Google mailbox (OAuth with PKCE, AES-256-GCM encrypted refresh token, disconnect/revoke), the EmailProvider port with its Gmail adapter, approved sends on the canonical relationship and reply tracking by Gmail history (Pub/Sub push verified by Google OIDC, plus polling). Provider calls only through injected HTTP; no provider SDK.
